_comment: Committed registry of marae Supabase projects, replacing the old local/uncommitted deploy-projects.conf. role drives execution order in apply-to-all.sh (test, then canary, then production) -- it replaces every per-name special case (e.g. the old `if [ "$NAME" = "opeke" ]` gate) in the deploy-*.sh scripts. A function or scheduled job is assumed to belong on EVERY project by default -- excluded_functions / excluded_jobs list the deliberate exceptions, each with a required reason, so tooling can tell a deliberate gap from a real one instead of silently alerting (or silently deploying) either way. scripts/generate-expected-deployment.js reads this file (plus the supabase/functions directory listing) to produce supabase/functions/check-deadlines/expectedDeployment.ts. TEST: Keep this file and live reality in sync by hand until there's a command that can do it for you.
